instruction: Feed IronCore::routing_peer_seen from every non-swarm data-link establish path (BLE / WiFiAware / WiFiDirect) in core/src/mobile_bridge.rs, using the SAME single core entry point the swarm ConnectionEstablished handler uses, failing closed for blocked peers and unknown cores, and inventing no second routing-presence API. Tests: blocked peer gets no feed; establish makes the routing engine LocalCell learn the peer.
files_touched: core/src/mobile_bridge.rs (+146/-1) -- only file changed on this branch
acceptance: Grep: the routing feed is reachable from non-swarm establish paths
Unit test: blocked peer -> no routing feed (fails closed)
Unit test: establish -> routing engine LocalCell learns the peer and decides Direct/WiFiAware
No second routing-presence API introduced; routing_peer_seen is the only entry
No 'WiFi fixed' claim: WP5 live 3-node proof is still outstanding and is not asserted here
